description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Notify the Excise Duty on Cigars, Cheroots, Cigarillos & Cigarettes of tobacco or of tobacco substitutes
reasoning: This gazette notification contains an order under the Excise (Special Provisions) Act, No. 13 of 1989, which establishes new regulatory rates for excise duties on tobacco products. It amends previous regulations and sets specific compliance requirements, making it primarily about legal/regulatory framework rather than government personnel/structure (Types 1-3) or other specialized categories.
